name: Aegon I Targaryen
description: The first King of the Seven Kingdoms. Conquered Westeros with his sisters and three dragons, forging the Iron Throne from the swords of his enemies.

name: Daenerys Targaryen
description: The last scion of House Targaryen. Hatched three dragons from stone eggs and crossed the narrow sea to reclaim her family's throne.

name: Aemond Targaryen
description: Prince during the Dance of the Dragons. Lost his eye as a child claiming Vhagar, the largest dragon alive at the time.

name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
description: Named heir to the Iron Throne by her father Viserys I. Her claim was contested by her half-brother Aegon II, igniting the Dance of the Dragons.

name: Jon Snow
description: Raised as a bastard of Winterfell, later revealed as the son of Rhaegar Targaryen and Lyanna Stark — the true heir to the Iron Throne.

name: Visenya Targaryen
description: Elder sister-wife of Aegon the Conqueror. A fierce warrior who rode Vhagar during the conquest of Westeros.

name: Laena Velaryon
description: Daughter of Corlys Velaryon. She claimed Vhagar and rode her until her tragic death at Driftmark.

name: Rhaenys Targaryen
description: Passed over for the throne despite being the eldest grandchild of Jaehaerys I. Rode Meleys until her death at Rook's Rest.

name: Daemon Targaryen
description: Younger brother of King Viserys I. A brilliant but dangerous prince who rode Caraxes into battle across three continents.

name: Rhaenys Targaryen
description: Passed over for the throne despite being the eldest grandchild of Jaehaerys I. Rode Meleys until her death at Rook's Rest.

name: Jaehaerys I Targaryen
description: The fourth Targaryen king, known as the Conciliator. His long reign was considered a golden age for the Seven Kingdoms.

name: Alysanne Targaryen
description: Wife of Jaehaerys I. Beloved queen who rode Silverwing and used her influence to improve the lives of women across the realm.

name: Aegon II Targaryen
description: Son of Viserys I who claimed the throne over his half-sister Rhaenyra. Rode the beautiful golden dragon Sunfyre.
